chapters.text: Review of the ambulance service contracts […] But I have a short three page note from him to read For the select board

chapters.label: Motion on the Peterborough ambulance contract
chapters.text: I'm going to make a motion that we go with Peterborough Fire and Rescue for the Ambulance Service. For next year and the year after, it will be a five year contract when we will evaluate after the second year. Each year is for the first two years, it will be $280,217.

chapters.label: Meetinghouse horse sheds
chapters.text: We're probably going to have to have another meeting house committee. […] Mike is expecting two more quotes.

chapters.label: Payroll and accounts payable
chapters.text: All right, let's move on to the approval of payroll for 9.17 and 9.24.

chapters.text: When are we going to receive the contract from Peterborough so that I can review it?

chapters.text: the ward and trust met yesterday. Yep. And we voted to add another 7,000 to the roof

chapters.label: Announcements
chapters.text: Of course, let's remind people that voting day is Tuesday, November 3rd. […] Let's try and get a 50% turnout. […] The town invites you to trick or treat on Halloween night. Saturday, October 31st from 4pm to 7pm.

chapters.label: CIP Committee appointment
chapters.text: So we need a few people to volunteer for that. I think we have one for the audience tonight.

chapters.label: Approval of minutes
chapters.text: I'll make a motion to approve 9-9, 26, 9-23, 26, and 4-22, 26. Seconded by Tom. All in favor? Aye.

chapters.label: Livestream: ending Town Hall Streams
chapters.text: So for the last two years or so, the town we're just using this live streaming company called Town Hall Streams, […] to basically broadcast these so people can come and and watch. You can watch later on. The contract is coming up.

chapters.text: This is the official proposal to make the executive secretary role full time of the hours that was previously established.

chapters.text: Earlier this year, I put in a grant to the state of New Hampshire for the Emergency Management Performance Grant. We've got a soft offer of $4,500.
